correctness.rationale: Complete 32-state addition NFA with exact carry/adjacent-block parity invariant; product of its subset determinization with saturating exception recognizer has precisely 88 reachable states and zero accept-predicate mismatches for each parity pair. Reproducible code builds all transitions from first principles, verifies every reachable state, and independently checks direct integer representations for n<3000. No finite sample is asserted to prove the infinite theorem; the exhaustive finite automaton equivalence is the proof.
